verdict.rationale: Gemini's Deep Research feature explicitly lets users delegate an open-ended research task that the assistant works through autonomously (using Search, Gmail, Drive, etc.) and returns a report, and scheduled/recurring actions let users set up background tasks (e.g., daily digests) that run without supervision. However, evidence is limited to these two narrow task types rather than general-purpose autonomous multi-step task execution across arbitrary domains, and there's no hands-on/independent confirmation of quality or reliability of the background review workflow. Missing for 10: broader agentic task delegation beyond research/scheduling, independent hands-on validation of background task quality, and details on how results are surfaced for review.
